name: Local optimum: L looks closest to G but is a dead end
note: Unit costs, goal G (h is admissible). From S the neighbour L (h = 1) looks better than B (h = 2). Hill climbing moves to L and STOPS there: S (3) and X (4) are worse, and G is not reached. Beam search with w = 1 also dies (L, then X, then no new nodes), but with w = 2 the beam keeps B alive next to L and reaches G through S–B–C–G (cost 3). Best First is not trapped because OPEN remembers B (it wastes expansions on L first).
